obligations.ask: Submit a written response about the check-up

results.segment: A written response about the check-up is required within 28 days of the date of this letter.
The check-up is being checked by the department that holds it, and any correction is applied automatically within 30 days.
This part of the letter is sent for information only.
We have already passed your details to the billing team, who will make the change within 10 days.
